action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate input matrices
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain nonpositive log probabilities")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("all matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted losses
    def weighted_loss(logp_mat: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        neg_logp = -logp_mat
        return np.dot(neg_logp, normalized_weights)

    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_empty = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
